feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete car selection and original front-end sprite and mask appearance consistent when UITextureReplacement switches between custom DDS and original textures, including live toggle, successful reload, and independent shader/VR-eye presentation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only UI replacement DDS ratio ownership, the original xstset texture slots, put_sprite_ex and put_sprite_ex2/mask producer hooks and their source semantics. Leave DDS decode formats, world textures, SkyGlow, OpenXR eye WVP, R26_SAFE and DX11/DXVK untouched.
trace_stages: The original UI DDS hook selects texture replacements and caches source-to-replacement ratios keyed by xstset slot in HandleTexture; a live preference change can retain prior ratios.

get_texture binds sprite texture identity for put_sprite_ex2 and its independent mask, while put_sprite_ex applies the same cached ratio directly to SPRARGS; both previously ignored the live UITextureReplacement flag.

The original game sprite queue and exact VR semantic registration hand these vertices through R84 R33/R30 binocular HUD or frontend scene rendering and host, while native original-DDS reload retires stale slot ratios.
subcomponents: Revoke stale get_texture and mask pointer provenance on live disable and gate both pointer-based put_sprite_ex2 and direct put_sprite_ex scale transformations on the effective setting.

Track xstset slot DDS load even when replacement was turned off so a successful native sprite reload clears its prior ratio; retain failed decode restoration and replace repeated hot-path map probes with one lookup per consumer.
Extend existing DDS source-mutation regression verifier and compile-time positive/negative ratio eligibility cases without changing native sprite producer geometry or world/VR eye transforms.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Car selection and front-end SPRARGS/SPRARGS2/mask geometry after live replacement toggle
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Disabling UI replacement immediately stops applying stale sprite and mask ratios and revokes pending get_texture provenance while keeping original game producer and stereo semantics unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original DDS reload and malformed/failed optional replacement with recycled xstset slots
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Successful original texture load retires stale scale even with preference disabled; failed decode keeps prior valid state and native fallback; live enabled scaling uses exactly one cached ratio lookup.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Default R84 Win32 game DLL, R26_SAFE, x64 host, package and affected HUD/Domain/static checks
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Changed-area source mutation regression and exact-SHA GitHub Active/Domain/Full Source gate run without CI skip; Quest3 selection colors, screen ratio and eye overlays remain separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At the verified base source, get_texture_dest and both put_sprite_ex paths applied cached replacement ratios without consulting the live UITextureReplacement setting. UiDdsOriginalState returned early on disabled replacement, leaving stale ratios when original DDS was subsequently reloaded.
diagnosis.root_cause: The ratio cache and pending pointer provenance outlived a live UI replacement preference change. Fast texture creation and sprite drawing used separate setting eligibility, so native car-selection sprites could inherit a previous replacement's crop dimensions.
source_trace: src/hooks_textures.cpp HandleTexture caches ratios and UiDdsOriginalState snapshots/resets xstset scale slots before and after DDS replacement and original fallback.

src/hooks_textures.cpp get_texture_dest provides source texture pointer identity; put_sprite_ex2 and mask rescale and put_sprite_ex direct rectangle rescale are gated by the same live option and one map lookup.
The original SpriteNode/Sumo queue tagging remains unchanged through VR semantic assignment to R84 main renderer and OpenXR host; per-eye HMD outcome still needs an actual Quest3 test.
alternatives_rejected: Changing global HUD scale, VR eye matrix or forcing menu cropping cannot fix stale CPU sprite UV transformations when texture replacement is disabled.
Clearing every scale map on a failed DDS load would corrupt still valid replacement sprites; successful original reload alone may retire stale slot ratios.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Patch gates all get_texture/SPRARGS/SPRARGS2/mask ratio paths on live UITextureReplacement and retires recycled xstset slot scale after successful original DDS load, preserving the original texture fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ static_assert covers live setting on/off and source identity; the existing HUD DDS verifier gains source obligations and destructive mutations for the toggle, independent mask, and single-lookup paths.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Existing queue registration and R84 stereo renderer own per-eye rendering; this patch changes only the original-game CPU sprite texture scale, not eye-specific matrices.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No matching Quest3/VDXR hardware test or Windows CI result at commit creation; BUILD_VERIFIED and visible selection success are not asserted.

runtime_evidence: No matching Quest3/VDXR or physical game execution performed.
